description: This file contains the implementation of the NoteRepository class, which manages data access operations for notes in the application using Entity Framework Core. It provides methods for retrieving, adding, updating, and removing notes, and saving changes to the database.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: EF Core implementation of notes repository, handling CRUD operations for notes in the database.

methods.name: GetByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID and owner ID asynchronously.

methods.name: GetAllForUserAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all notes for a specific user, ordered by latest update.

methods.name: AddAsync
methods.description: Adds a new note asynchronously to the database.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Updates an existing note in the database.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes a note from the database.

methods.name: SaveChangesAsync
methods.description: Saves all pending changes to the database asynchronously.
